chunks: It is God who created you of weakness, then after weakness gave you strength, then after strength will give you weakness and grey hair. Surely He makes whatever He wills. He is all-knowing and all-powerful.
ai.seo_question: What are the three stages of human life described in Surah Ar-Rum?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to illustrate the cyclical nature of human vitality and the inevitability of aging as a sign of God's creative power. It underscores the transient nature of worldly strength, encouraging believers to reflect on their spiritual preparation during their period of vigor. The mention of 'grey hair' (shaybah) serves as a tangible reminder of mortality, aligning with the Shia emphasis on *dhikr* (remembrance) and *mawt* (death) as motivators for righteous action.
